title: Sector Overview #3 | Renewable Energy | November 2026
author: Alexis Rondeaux
summary: Renewables are still being built at record pace, but the money is moving from panels to grids: China's solar installations halved, Europe struggles with negative prices, and network-heavy utilities outperform pure clean energy players.
key_takeaways: Market size: global renewable capacity additions +16% to about 800 GW in 2025 (IEA); renewables investment -9.5% in 2025 (BNEF)
China: solar installations -54% year on year to 110.8 GW in the first nine months of 2026 after the move to market-based pricing
Company results: Iberdrola 9M net profit +10% (guidance raised); First Solar Q3 sales -23%; S&P Global Clean Energy index +1.3% year to date in mid-October
Europe: 596 negative-price hours in Spain in H1 2026; 46.8% of German solar output in April 2026 produced at negative prices
US: wind and solar had to start construction by 4 July 2026 to keep tax credits; NextEra to combine with Dominion (about $66.8bn)
disclaimer: Student research for educational purposes only. Not investment advice.
